minimum_fields_needed: target vehicle class; stop-start exposure; low-speed steering use-case; EPS platform name
why_needed: FAM08/FAM02/FAM11が対象EPSに適用できるか判定する
acceptable_placeholder: target EPS has low-speed steering assist; stop-start unknown

minimum_fields_needed: test case ID; scenario name; speed range; steering input; injected fault/condition; expected DTC/state
why_needed: 既存HILS test planの焼き直しか判断する
proceed_if: 同等scenarioがない、または診断確認なし
hold_if: test listはあるが詳細不明
kill_if: 同等scenario + diagnostic checkが既に十分

minimum_fields_needed: DTC ID; fault condition; enable condition; status bits; freeze frame trigger; safety reaction
why_needed: FAM familyごとに既存診断で説明できるか見る
proceed_if: DTCはあるがFAM factsの一部が未covered

minimum_fields_needed: field name; capture timing; retention; readout path; unit/resolution
DID; readable source; bench/field/returned-part availability; access restriction
why_needed: readerでcoverage matrixを埋められるか見る
kill_if: readerで主要factが十分読め、gapなし

minimum_fields_needed: assist command; actual current; current limit; tracking error; derating state; monitor availability
voltage rails; overvoltage; reset; brownout; DC link; capture timing
why_needed: FAM08 power transient / FAM02 voltage/thermal文脈を見る
proceed_if: power transientをHILSで再現できるがsnapshot不足
kill_if: 電源文脈が既存診断で十分

minimum_fields_needed: calibration ID; software DID; release gate checklist; failsafe test evidence
proceed_if: release gateにFAM scenario coverageを追加できる
kill_if: release processに同等coverageが既にある

minimum_fields_needed: meeting name; template; decision fields; owner; frequency
hold_if: 会議体候補はあるがtemplateなし
kill_if: 貼る場所がなく資料が独立する

minimum_fields_needed: Program A/B names; shared platform; DTC spec availability; HILS library availability
acceptable_placeholder: one current + one legacy program candidate
hold_if: 候補はあるが資料不足
kill_if: 比較対象がなく単発NREになる
